properties.notes: The site comprises a former transport yard containing a workshop building, a glazing business unit, a number of containers and hardstanding. There are also other vehicle-related uses on the site including a car wash. Bounded by Ash Road and a residential unit to the east, and open countryside to the north, west and south.
